content.text: All policy tests pass. Now the ledger semantics — replay, conflict, TTL expiry, capacity eviction:

arguments.command:
cat > /app/tmp/t/t5_ledger.py << 'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/tmp/t')
from harness import *

def reqf(frm="sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t", cid="demo", cseq="7 MESSAGE",
         extra=None, body=b"", to="sip:bob@lab.test", method="MESSAGE",
         uri="sip:bob@lab.test", tag=None):
    hs = [("From", frm), ("To", to), ("Call-ID", cid), ("CSeq", cseq), ("Content-Length", str(len(body)))]
    if extra: hs.extend(extra)
    return mkreq(method=method, uri=uri, headers=hs, body=body)

def run_events(evs, ttl=1000, cap=10, cfg=None):
    if cfg is None:
        cfg = base_config(ttl=ttl, cap=cap)
    rc, out, err = run(envelope(evs, cfg))
    assert rc == 0, (rc, err[:400])
    return json.loads(out)

def E(t, wire, peer="edge", auth="alice", eg="external"):
    return ev(t, peer, auth, eg, h(wire))

G = reqf()
G2 = reqf(body=b"x")   # different body, same key

# accept then replay
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1, G)])
expect("replay basic", r["results"][1]["decision"] == "replay" and r["results"][1]["first"] == 0 and r["live"] == 1 and r["accepted"] == 1 and r["replayed"] == 1, r)

# conflict on body change
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1, G2)])
expect("conflict body", r["results"][1]["reason"] == "conflict" and r["live"] == 1, r)

# lexical retransmission is a replay (different spelling, same commitment)
Lex = reqf(frm="sip:alice@lab.test ; tag = t", extra=[("X-Note","ignored"),("Privacy","none")], body=b"")
# note: privacy none vs absent differ in commitment; use same privacy
Lex = mkreq(uri="SIP:bob@lab.test", headers=[("f","sip:alice@lab.test ; TAG = t"),("t","sip:bob@lab.test"),("i","demo"),("CSeq","0007 MESSAGE"),("Privacy","none"),("l","0")])
Gn  = reqf(extra=[("Privacy","none")])
r = run_events([E(0, Gn), E(1, Lex)])
expect("lexical replay", r["results"][1]["decision"] == "replay", r["results"][1])

# tag change -> conflict
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1, reqf(frm="sip:alice@lab.test;tag=u"))])
expect("tag change conflict", r["results"][1]["reason"] == "conflict", r["results"][1])

# alternate From alias -> conflict (different commitment: input From URI)
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1, reqf(frm="sip:desk@lab.test;tag=t"))])
expect("alt from alias conflict", r["results"][1]["reason"] == "conflict", r["results"][1])

# changed asserted alias -> conflict
P1 = reqf(extra=[("P-Preferred-Identity","<sip:alice@lab.test>")])
P2 = reqf(extra=[("P-Preferred-Identity","<sip:desk@lab.test>")])
r = run_events([E(0, P1), E(1, P2)])
expect("asserted change conflict", r["results"][1]["reason"] == "conflict", r["results"][1])

# egress change -> conflict
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1, G, eg="internal")])
expect("egress change conflict", r["results"][1]["reason"] == "conflict", r["results"][1])

# privacy change -> conflict
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1, reqf(extra=[("Privacy","none")]))])
expect("privacy change conflict", r["results"][1]["reason"] == "conflict", r["results"][1])

# target change -> conflict (different key? no: same callid/cseq/method, different target)
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1, reqf(to="sip:bob@lab.test", uri="sip:bob@lab.test"))])
T2 = mkreq(uri="sip:bob@lab.test", headers=[("From","sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t"),("To","sip:bob@lab.test"),("Call-ID","demo"),("CSeq","7 MESSAGE"),("Content-Length","0")])
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1, T2)])
expect("same target replay", r["results"][1]["decision"] == "replay", r["results"][1])
T3 = mkreq(uri="sip:desk@lab.test", headers=[("From","sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t"),("To","sip:desk@lab.test"),("Call-ID","demo"),("CSeq","7 MESSAGE"),("Content-Length","0")])
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1, T3)])
expect("target change conflict", r["results"][1]["reason"] == "conflict", r["results"][1])

# key distinctions: call-id, cseq, method, peer
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1, reqf(cid="other"))])
expect("callid distinct key", r["results"][1]["decision"] == "accept" and r["live"] == 2, r)
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1, reqf(cseq="8 MESSAGE"))])
expect("cseq distinct key", r["results"][1]["decision"] == "accept", r["results"][1])
Iv = reqf(method="INVITE", cseq="7 INVITE")
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1, Iv)])
expect("method distinct key", r["results"][1]["decision"] == "accept", r["results"][1])
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1, G, peer="trunk", auth=None)])
expect("peer distinct key", r["results"][1]["decision"] == "reject", r["results"][1])  # relay needs PAI
Rl = reqf(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity","<sip:alice@lab.test>")])
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1, Rl, peer="trunk", auth=None)])
expect("peer distinct key 2", r["results"][1]["decision"] == "accept" and r["live"] == 2, r)

# call-id case sensitivity in key
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1, reqf(cid="Demo"))])
expect("callid case distinct", r["results"][1]["decision"] == "accept", r["results"][1])

# TTL expiry: t >= first_insert + ttl removes
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(999, G)], ttl=1000)
expect("ttl just before", r["results"][1]["decision"] == "replay", r["results"][1])
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1000, G)], ttl=1000)
expect("ttl exact reaccept", r["results"][1]["decision"] == "accept" and r["results"][1]["first"] == 1 and r["live"] == 1, r["results"][1])
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1001, G)], ttl=1000)
expect("ttl after", r["results"][1]["decision"] == "accept", r["results"][1])
# expiry happens even for rejected/malformed events
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1000, "zz", raw_hex := None) if False else E(1000, G), E(1000, "zz")], ttl=1000)
expect("expiry before bad hex", r["results"][2]["reason"] == "hex" and r["live"] == 1, r)
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1000, G), E(1000, G2)], ttl=1000)
expect("expired then conflict-free", r["results"][1]["decision"] == "accept" and r["results"][2]["decision"] == "accept", r["results"])
# expiry uses insertion time not last touch: replay does not refresh
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(500, G), E(1000, G)], ttl=1000)
expect("replay no refresh", [x["decision"] for x in r["results"]] == ["accept", "replay", "accept"], r["results"])
# conflict does not refresh either
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(500, G2), E(1000, G)], ttl=1000)
expect("conflict no refresh", [x.get("decision") for x in r["results"]] == ["accept", "reject", "accept"], r["results"])

# capacity eviction: oldest insertion index evicted
r = run_events([E(0, reqf(cid="a")), E(1, reqf(cid="b")), E(2, reqf(cid="a"))], cap=2)
expect("cap replay before evict", r["results"][2]["decision"] == "replay" and r["live"] == 2, r["results"][2])
r = run_events([E(0, reqf(cid="a")), E(1, reqf(cid="b")), E(2, reqf(cid="c")), E(3, reqf(cid="a"))], cap=2)
expect("eviction then reaccept", [x.get("decision") for x in r["results"]] == ["accept", "accept", "accept", "accept"] and r["results"][3]["first"] == 3 and r["live"] == 2, r["results"])
# evicted entry is the oldest insertion index (a), so b survives
r = run_events([E(0, reqf(cid="a")), E(1, reqf(cid="b")), E(2, reqf(cid="c")), E(3, reqf(cid="b"))], cap=2)
expect("b survives eviction", r["results"][3]["decision"] == "replay" and r["results"][3]["first"] == 1, r["results"][3])
# capacity 1
r = run_events([E(0, reqf(cid="a")), E(1, reqf(cid="a")), E(2, reqf(cid="b")), E(3, reqf(cid="a"))], cap=1)
expect("cap 1", [x.get("decision") for x in r["results"]] == ["accept", "replay", "accept", "accept"], r["results"])
# rejected events do not insert
r = run_events([E(0, "zz"), E(1, G)], cap=1)
expect("reject no insert", r["results"][0]["reason"] == "hex" and r["results"][1]["decision"] == "accept" and r["live"] == 1, r)
# equal times: no expiry when t == insert time with ttl>=1
r = run_events([E(5, G), E(5, G)], ttl=1)
expect("equal times replay", r["results"][1]["decision"] == "replay", r["results"][1])
# expiry with equal insert times
r = run_events([E(5, reqf(cid="a")), E(5, reqf(cid="b")), E(6, reqf(cid="a"))], ttl=1)
expect("equal insert expire", r["results"][2]["decision"] == "accept", r["results"][2])
# many events, capacity smaller
evs = [E(i, reqf(cid="c%d" % i)) for i in range(10)]
r = run_events(evs, cap=3)
expect("many cap 3", r["live"] == 3 and r["accepted"] == 10, r)
# summary counts
r = run_events([E(0, G), E(1, G), E(2, G2), E(3, "zz")])
expect("counts", (r["accepted"], r["replayed"], r["rejected"], r["live"]) == (1, 1, 2, 1), r)
summary()
